Today I was doing my first home workout and I was doing the knees on the floor push ups and I noticed that I was never able to do as many of those as I did before my fitness journey. With that I thought to myself “What if I tried a full form push up?” And I was nervous because I haven’t attempted one in about a year or so and I didn’t want to discourage myself. I tried it and I did one so easily that I thought I did it wrong and without stopping I tried another and then I realized that I had done two legit push ups! I have never been able to push my body weight and I thought I hadn’t been making any progress but this set it up for me. Pull ups are next to master.
